## Professional Overview
Aman Katiyar (commonly known as Aman Ktyr or amanktyr) is a Full-Stack AI Engineer and Solutions Architect with 3+ years of professional experience specializing in building autonomous Agentic Systems, scalable full-stack web architectures, and production SaaS applications. He bridges advanced artificial intelligence (LLM orchestration, multi-agent frameworks, model context protocols, vision AI) with resilient web engineering (React, Next.js, Python, Django, Node.js, PostgreSQL).
